caveats.assignment: Assigned volume is the assignment-v10 node-to-facility transport-aware planning allocation, not a legal AAC, sustainable-supply determination, or observed harvest outcome. The eligible facility set, capacity-v3 bounds and the 1.2x proxy floor are unchanged across the three harvest cases. Cross-border volume is a screening transport-allocation result, not a trade forecast.
caveats.capacity: Published capacity mixes 2015 BC Mills DB infeed proxies, 2026 Quebec permitted input volume, 2025 finished-pellet bulk volume converted at 650 kg/m3, and converted company sawn output. The bases are not interchangeable. A permit is a ceiling, not observed throughput.
caveats.location: Coordinates are plant or city-centroid locations, not verified plant-gate geometry. Records without coordinates are retained in the table and are not mapped; no location is invented.
caveats.national_chain: Frozen v5.1 national chain. Assignment v10 node transport-aware flows at 100/119/150 Mm³; capacity v3 and the 1.2x floor are unchanged. E1 measured coefficients for BC/QC/NB/YT and E2c imputed coefficients for nine jurisdictions; donor product coefficients = 0. Products and residue are invariant to assignment at fixed harvest; facility distribution and truck transport cost are not. Transport cost is not an OSeCAN input. Harvest 0.60 is a reference recovery scenario, not a calibrated factor. model_estimate · observed=false · policy_grade=false. No official OSeCAN change and no new proxy capacity.
caveats.no_osecan: Read-only. This view is outside the LP and public OSeCAN surfaces and contains no run or solver controls.
caveats.no_ranking: This ledger is evidence coverage and accounting only. No facility, province, or class ranking is performed or implied.
caveats.proxy: Proxy capacity is a class-median placeholder for blank relevant-class records. It is not a facility measurement, not observed capacity, and not evidence of provincial self-sufficiency.
caveats.status: Most operating statuses are unknown. A published capacity record does not prove current operation.
caveats.transport: Transport cost is trucking only (transport cost v1 applied to haversine x province-factor screening distances). It excludes feedstock, processing, conversion, handling, storage, border, ferry and winter-road costs. It is not an OSeCAN input, not observed, and not policy grade.
caveats.utilization: Table utilization is assigned volume divided by eligible v10 capacity: located, operating records after the unchanged 1.2x proxy floor. It is not observed operating utilization and is not a performance ranking.
